questions.stem: Why can thousands of different proteins be made from only 20 amino acids?

options.text: Each amino acid can change its shape
Amino acids can bond with lipids to create variety
The amino acids can be arranged in many different sequences and chain lengths

questions.explanation: The huge variety of proteins comes from the different sequences and lengths possible. Even a short chain of amino acids has an enormous number of possible combinations, and sequence determines the protein's final shape and function.
